newsitem.title: DENMARK: ISS up 6 pct on unit sale, reports.
newsitem.headline: ISS up 6 pct on unit sale, reports.

text.p: Danish cleaners International Service System (ISS) rose six percent on Monday after selling its U.S. unit and becoming the subject of positive reports.
At 1040 GMT the share was up nine crowns, to 155 crowns.
"The rise is because of clarification of the situation in the United States, positive newspaper articles and, not least, more positive recommendations in the market," a dealer said.
The company on Friday announced that it had no further liabilities regarding its loss-making ISS Inc, following its sale to Canada's Aaxis Ltd.
